_doc: Curated villain defeat-requirement markers (WP-292 / D-24076). apply-defeat-requirement-markers.mjs appends a [require-to-defeat:<kind>:<value>] marker to the single ability line carrying the inline [<kind>:<value>] token on each named card. `kind` is the marker token: `team` or `hc` (hc → engine 'hero-class'). Pins exact set/group/card so look-alikes (e.g. the cvwr Size-Changing 'Venom') are never touched.
